messages:
anya (Product): Quick sync — proposing our annual planning offsite. Dates available: Apr 27-28 (Tue/Wed) or Apr 28-29 (Wed/Thu). Preference poll inside. Need to lock date, facilitators, and pre-reads. Remote streaming required. Tagging @carmen for logistics. :calendar:

carmen (People Ops): Venue confirmed for Apr 28-29 at The Foundry (capacity 80). Budget approved. I'll start booking travel and hotel blocks. Please add dietary restrictions here: https://forms.company/dietary

ben (Eng): 28-29 works for Eng. Need a separate breakout room for infra (35p) + AV for livestream and mics.

eva (DevEx): Draft agenda:
```
Day 1 AM: Strategy + company context
Day 1 PM: OKR deep dives + cross-team tradeoffs
Day 2 AM: Customer use-cases + product-spec workshops
Day 2 PM: Commitments, rollouts, and retro
```
I'll circulate pre-read by Apr 7. Want to reserve 90m for roadmap alignment and 60m for model-eval session.

david (Research): Please include a 'model-quality & risk' 90min slot (sandbox + eval metrics). Also need GPU infra people in that session.

anya (Product): Facilitators so far: milan (product lead) and sam (eng director). Need someone to run the retro. Decision rule proposal: scope decisions need 2/3 participating stakeholder sign-off; unresolved items escalate to execs by EOD Fri after offsite.

ben (Eng): I can facilitate the retro.

carmen (People Ops): I'll create calendar invites, travel policy link, and a lodging email. Will collect RSVP + remote/onsite preference. ETA invites by EOD Thu.

calendar-bot: Poll created — 28-29 preferred (14 votes), 27-28 (6 votes).

anya (Product): Great — locking Apr 28-29. Action items:
- carmen: book venue + hotel blocks + travel form
- eva: finalize agenda + pre-read by Apr 7
- david & ben: define attendees for model-eval + infra workshop
- milan & sam: prep facilitation notes and decider list

If anyone needs remote-only option or has conflicts, flag them here. Thanks :raised_hands:
